messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 Pager: High error rate detected for dedicated cluster 'cinderbank-prod' (us-west1). 5xx spike ~12% above baseline. Trigger: routing-error-threshold. Pager -> oncall-jordan
oncall-jordan: ACK. I'm on it, looking at tail of inference logs and node metrics.
ops-ryan: seeing repeated redis timeouts and kernel OOM events on node g4-12-5-3. Process restarts correlated with spikes.
oncall-jordan: scope check — is this isolated to CinderBank's dedicated pool?
incident-bot: Customer impact: yes. Affected account: CinderBank (dedicated). Approx 35% of their API calls to /v1/generate are failing or hitting 5-10s latencies.
liaison-emily: Paging CinderBank support contacts now (ops-team + ops-lead@cinderbank.com). I'll open a support ticket and DM primary contact.
cs-venkat: Suggest short, non-alarm customer line: "We're investigating degraded responses from your dedicated cluster and have routed traffic to a standby pool. We'll update within 30 minutes."
oncall-jordan: Initial mitigation: cordoning node g4-12-5-3 and draining. Starting rolling restart of affected worker pods.
eng-ml-ana: FYI — if KV cache becomes inconsistent after restarts we could see cold-start latency spikes even after routing. Watch evictions and kv-cache-hit-rate.
ops-ryan: Confirmed dmesg shows repeated OOM kills for inference_worker PID 2345. Swap pressure high. Looks like a memory leak in the 3.1.2 worker image under this model profile.
oncall-jordan: Executing temporary routing override to shift new traffic to passive pool in us-west2 for cinderbank-prod: `redwoodctl routing override --account cinderbank --to us-west2 --reason "mitigate OOM restarts"`
ops-ryan: override accepted, starting gradual shift (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Monitoring error rate during ramp.
incident-bot: Automation: scaling passive pool +3 GPUs for cinderbank-prod in us-west2. Expected capacity increase within 2m.
oncall-jordan: After shift, errors down from 35% -> 8%. Residual failures are older inflight requests queued on drained nodes. Still investigating root cause and preparing customer comms.
liaison-emily: CinderBank responded: "This affects nightly settlement jobs — high priority for us." They're asking for ETA on full recovery.
cs-venkat: Draft customer update (15m): short status, actions we've taken, ETA 60m, ask to pause big batches.
status-bot: Suggested status page copy (short):
```
Status: Degraded — partial outage impacting requests to dedicated cluster cinderbank-prod (us-west1).
Impact: Some API calls return 5xx or high latency.
Mitigation: Traffic routed to standby cluster in us-west2; rolling restarts and worker image patch in progress.
ETA: Customers should see recovery within 60 minutes.
```
oncall-jordan: Rolling patch plan: 1) patch worker image to bump oom_score_adj and reduce mem footprint, 2) restart nodes one-at-a-time, 3) monitor kv-cache metrics. Applying patch to one node now.
eng-runtime-maya: Preparing image change with kernel tunables and a quick mem sanitizer. Will push canary to one node, then roll if green.
ops-ryan: Canary finished, no OOM after 10m under load. Initiating rolling rollout across remaining affected nodes.
liaison-emily: Sent customer update DM: short + actions + ask to hold big jobs. CinderBank replied: "Appreciate the quick response, we'll hold the large batches until you confirm."
noncall-jordan: Monitoring: errors now <1% in us-west2 path, cold-start latencies trending down. Leaving routing override in place until all nodes fully patched and stable for 30m.
eng-ml-ana: Post-recovery next steps: reproduce mem growth locally against their model profile and add regression test in CI for KV cache stability.
cs-venkat: Preparing post-incident customer note template for CinderBank (include timeline, mitigation, next steps, ETA for permanent fix).
status-bot: Proposed customer resolution note (short):
```
Hi CinderBank team —
We routed your traffic to a standby pool and applied a worker image patch to address a memory regression causing process restarts. Error rates have returned to normal and we're monitoring for 30 minutes before removing the temporary routing override. We're scheduling a follow-up call + RCA. — Redwood Inference
```
oncall-jordan: Handoff: I'm clearing the pager in 30m and handing follow-up to eng-runtime-maya for RCA and long-term fix. Leaving note in incident channel and on ticket.
eng-runtime-maya: Acknowledged. I'll own the RCA and coordinate changelist + CI regression. Scheduling postmortem with CinderBank and internal stakeholders.
ops-ryan: Reverting routing override in 20m if stability holds.
liaison-emily: I'll send the customer resolution note once we confirm the 30m stable window.
incident-bot: Incident update: SEVERITY P2. Incident declared RESOLVED by oncall-jordan. Duration: ~32 minutes. Final status: error rate back to baseline, routing override removed at 6321113400, follow-up RCA scheduled.
oncall-jordan: Thanks team. Key actions for the follow-up: reproduce mem leak, add CI test, include contact routing checklist for future dedicated failures (primary phone/email, backup escalation), update runbook entries about routing overrides.
cs-venkat: I'll draft the tailored customer postmortem and include next steps and dates.
eng-runtime-maya: Will post RCA draft in #eng-runtime in 48h.
liaison-emily: Closing ticket to customer after resolution note sent.
ops-ryan: Leaving logs and core dumps in S3 under s3://redwood-incidents/cinderbank/6321112222 for the RCA.
oncall-jordan: End of thread. If anything flares, re-pager oncall as usual. :thumbsup:
